rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an unspecified thing or things.

example.english: There’s something in the box, so don’t touch it.
example.traditional: 個箱入面有啲嘢，唔好亂咁掂。
example.jyutping: go3 soeng1 jap6 min6 jau5 di1 je5 m4 hou2 lyun6 gam2 dim6

rows.note: Use this when you want to emphasize one particular item rather than unspecified stuff generally.

example.english: I just want to buy something—just one item.
example.jyutping: ngo5 zing6 hai6 soeng2 maai5 jat1 joeng6 je5 zaa3

rows.note: Use this for some particular but unnamed things, often when contrasting them with other things.

example.english: There’s something that has to be kept separately; it can’t go with the other things.
example.traditional: 某啲嘢要另外擺，唔可以同其他嘢放埋一齊。
example.jyutping: mau5 di1 je5 jiu3 ling6 ngoi6 baai2 m4 ho2 ji5 tung4 kei4 taa1 je5 fong3 maai4 jat1 cai4
